```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(reactable)
```

```{r load, include=FALSE, cache=TRUE}
date_of_data_refresh <- "20201027"

source(here::here("utils", "load_sas_medidata.R"))
medidata <- load_sas_medidata(
  here::here("data", date_of_data_refresh, "c16_170_IRONMAN_586_20201027_173647")
)
```

## Treatments

The `treatment` table has `r nrow(medidata$treatment)` entries across `r n_distinct(medidata$treatment$subjectId)` patients. Approximate treatment sequences are provided below in comma separated format; be aware that these may not be strict sequential events due to concurrent therapies being reported in the same format.

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# loosely report sequence of treatments (concurrent treatments not handled separately)
treatments <- medidata$treatment %>% 
  select(subjectId, TREATMENT, EXSTDAT) %>%
  group_by(subjectId) %>% 
  arrange(EXSTDAT) %>% 
  count(TREATMENT) %>%
  summarise(treatment_sequence = paste(TREATMENT, collapse = ", "))

treatments %>% 
  count(treatment_sequence, sort = TRUE) %>%
  rename("Treatment sequence" = treatment_sequence) %>%
  reactable(sortable = TRUE, filterable = TRUE)
```

## Surgery

The `surg` table has `r nrow(medidata$surg)` entries across `r n_distinct(medidata$surg$subjectId)` patients.

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
surgeries <- medidata$surg %>%
  select(subjectId, SURGTYPE, SURGDT) %>%
  group_by(subjectId) %>%
  arrange(SURGDT) %>%
  count(SURGTYPE) %>%
  summarize(surgery = paste(SURGTYPE, collapse = ", "))

surgeries %>%
  count(surgery, sort = TRUE) %>%
  rename("Surgery sequence" = surgery) %>%
  reactable(sortable = TRUE, filterable = TRUE)
```

## Radiation

The `palliativeradiation` table has `r nrow(medidata$palliativeradiation)` entries across `r n_distinct(medidata$palliativeradiation$subjectId)` patients.

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
radiation <- medidata$palliativeradiation %>%
  select(subjectId, RADREG, RADREGDT) %>%
  group_by(subjectId) %>%
  arrange(RADREGDT) %>%
  count(RADREG) %>%
  summarize(radiation_sequence = paste(RADREG, collapse = ", "))

radiation %>%
  count(radiation_sequence, sort = TRUE) %>%
  rename("Radiation sequence" = radiation_sequence) %>%
  reactable(sortable = TRUE, filterable = TRUE)
```
